summary: This bill directs the Treasury Secretary to create a program to refund tariffs deemed invalid by the Supreme Court, but only to importers who demonstrate they will lower consumer prices for essential goods or provide rebates to customers, prohibiting stock buybacks or dividends until price reductions are certified.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly addresses tariffs, which are a core component of trade policy.
